target_perspective: External integrator operating outside the environment using only permitted public observations, policy probabilities, and episode reset signals.
question: Can an external integrator reduce repetitive failure loops in the frozen Phase 1 NumPy policy on dev seeds 0..99 using deterministic per-observation least-tried action selection, without retraining, privileged state, or expert labels, and at what override and state cost?

base_policy.policy_input_representation: 247-d engineered task-relative features derived from obs['image'] and obs['mission']

wrapper_specification.authoritative_selection_rule: lexicographic argmin over a in {0, 1, 2} of (counts[obs_key][a], -probs[a], a), evaluated identically on every call with no separate activation branch
wrapper_specification.override_definition: selected action != argmax(probs), which occurs iff counts[obs_key][argmax(probs)] > min(counts[obs_key])
wrapper_specification.observation_key: exact raw key (obs['image'].tobytes(), obs['mission']) derived strictly from permitted public observations (distinct from the policy's 247-d features)
wrapper_specification.retained_state: per-episode dict mapping obs_key -> [c_left, c_right, c_forward]
wrapper_specification.memory_disclosure: The complete wrapped system has episode-local memory in the execution wrapper; it must not be described as memoryless.
wrapper_specification.reset_condition: clear action_counts on episode start (env.reset boundary)
wrapper_specification.recovery_termination: implicit per step: unvisited observations have counts [0, 0, 0] and execute base argmax immediately; no exhaustion abort exists
wrapper_specification.tie_breaking_and_rng: deterministic (-probs[a], then lowest action index a); zero RNG calls
wrapper_specification.information_boundary: Wrapper receives ONLY obs['image'], obs['mission'], probs, and reset(); no env, seed, true pose, grid, target location, BabyAIBot, Phase 3 weights, or evaluator results.

baseline_preservation_invariant.expected_behavior: Phase 1 had 0 repeated raw observations across all 93 successful dev episodes; therefore all 93 must remain trajectory-identical under the wrapped policy.
baseline_preservation_invariant.interpretation_limit: Preserving all 93 baseline successes is an expected consequence of zero intervention on their non-repeating trajectories, not independent evidence that the wrapper is generally non-regressive on episodes with legitimate repeated observations.

evaluation_and_caps.phase3_reference: kept strictly separate as an expert-assisted reference

effectiveness: outcomes and changed failure patterns on seeds 3, 15, 29, 43, 50, 80, 94
episode lengths (all 100, successful only, common-success subset)
intervention_burden: total actions differing from base argmax
retained observation keys per episode (mean and peak)
decisions made where all three action counts were already >= 1 before the decision
distinct observation keys reaching full 3-action coverage (all three counts >= 1)
wall-clock timing measurement and explicit aborts/failures if any
